answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in quartz and signal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the thread graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1000 impostors cost 1240 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
